scope: Actual prototype action/context helpers in a Node VM. Checks local state transitions and bounded request context, not browser rendering or application runtime.

tests.name: Search action reveals a previously collapsed panel and focuses its input
Closing the middle active tab selects its right-hand neighbour
Closing the last active tab selects its left-hand neighbour
Closing an inactive tab keeps the active document
Closing the final tab leaves a genuine empty editor
Unsaved close keeps the document until the user makes a decision
Explicit panel selection opens it while toggling preserves the chosen section
Agent context uses the selected draft and its actual starting line
Agent context does not apply selection from another open document
Long agent context is bounded and clearly marked as a fragment
Empty-editor context cannot reference an old active file
Git context uses selected diff and branch rather than stale editor contents
